title: Canonical Verdier-exchange stage data and normalized comparisons
statement:
Use the coefficient stages and six operations of [def-fix-six-functor-datum], and the constructible coefficient categories, adjunctions and normalized scalar comparisons of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Y,S$, a coefficient stage $s$, compact-support/exceptional adjoint pairs $F_f\dashv G_f$, $F_a\dashv G_a$, $F_x\dashv G_x$ on these categories, and a coefficient unit $u$ on $S$. A Verdier-exchange stage datum consists of internal-Hom bifunctors $H_X,H_Y$ with closed tensor structures, an ordinary pullback/direct-image adjunction $P\dashv Q$, projection isomorphisms $F_f(PK\otimes M)\cong K\otimes F_fM$, and a dualizing comparison $c:G_fG_a u\cong G_xu$. Define $D_X=H_X(-,G_xu)$ and $D_Y=H_Y(-,G_au)$. Define the canonical arrow $\epsilon_M:D_Y(F_fM)\to QD_X(M)$ by applying projection and evaluation, transposing through $F_f\dashv G_f$, postcomposing with $c$, then transposing through tensor--Hom and $P\dashv Q$. Given a compact-support compositor $\alpha:F_a\circ F_f\cong F_x$, its right-adjoint composition comparison is the conjugate of $\alpha^{-1}$. A stage conclusion is a natural isomorphism $D_Y\circ F_f^{\mathrm{op}}\cong Q\circ D_X$ whose components are these $\epsilon_M$, with the duals, $Q$, and the isomorphism commuting with integer shifts on the opposite category.

At finite and integral ring stages, the unit is the actual coefficient sheaf in degree zero, internal Hom is the ambient derived internal Hom restricted by the finite-Tor inclusions, and realization data identify the displayed tensor, Hom, evaluation and pullback/direct-image adjunctions with the actual pro-etale operations. Projection realization uses the proper-counit/open-projection construction, normalized on K-flat representatives. Shift realization uses the signed Hom-complex comparison $(-1)^{mq}$ and its localization, restricting the ambient shifts to the constructible categories. Define the auxiliary ambient duals, substitution map, and exchange isomorphism by inverse tensor--Hom exchange followed by substitution of $c$.

Between two coefficient stages, scalar data consist of the three normalized exceptional comparisons, the coefficient-unit comparison, tensor and pullback comparisons, and the projection comparison equation. The dualizing comparisons $\kappa_X,\kappa_Y$ are the exceptional structure comparisons at the unit followed by its unit identification. Define the dual scalar arrows by extending evaluation and transposing, and define the direct-image scalar arrow as the counit-normalized mate of the pullback comparison. A scalar conclusion is the dualizing-mate equation and the exchange square for these arrows. Scalar shift data are natural transformations with these exact components commuting with integer shifts. The ring-unit scalar arrow is the scalar-adjunction transpose of the actual coefficient-sheaf restriction map localized in degree zero. For composable separated finite-type maps over the finite-field base, the integral compositor realization is the canonical completed compact-support compositor conjugated by the three recorded left realizations. These are construction data and compatibility predicates, without an assertion that a stage or scalar conclusion exists.
